taskTypes.label: Review
taskTypes.description: Blind review of another run's work, judged later by a second reviewer.

measures.label: Speed
measures.description: Median wall seconds per unit of work, in the task type's unit.

measures.label: Quality
measures.description: Share of the work a later blind review passed without overturning. Fix rounds on one item count once.

measures.label: Thoroughness
measures.description: Median of files read over files assigned and records judged over records assigned.

measures.label: Laziness
measures.description: Share of runs flagged incomplete-read or scope-cut, or that read under 90% of what was assigned.

measures.label: Cheating
measures.description: Share of runs flagged shortcut, cheating, fabricated, test-weakened or false-claim. Each one is listed with its evidence.

measures.label: Cost
measures.description: Measured credits or quota per accepted unit. Estimates are shown apart and labelled.

measures.label: Reliability
measures.description: Share of runs that started and did not end failed or cancelled for infrastructure reasons.

measures.label: Over-claimed passes
measures.description: Share of runs that reported passing checks which a later review overturned.

measures.label: Facts kept
measures.description: Scout: share of the known plan-changing facts that reached the final decisions.

measures.label: Verdict drift
measures.description: Scout: share of verdicts that differ from the reference model's.

measures.label: Silent misses
measures.description: Planning: share of the agreed obligations a run missed without flagging them.

uses.label: Building WorkNodes
uses.description: Which models to use to build, fix, test and review WorkNodes.

benchmarks.label: Scout test bed SV3/t9
benchmarks.description: One 4-capability Scout test bed with 127 known plan-changing facts. Controlled experiments: compare only within one process version.
benchmarks.scoring: Facts kept in the final decisions, picked by id; verdicts compared with the reference model.

benchmarks.label: Planning wizard pilot 2
benchmarks.description: 12 planning documents; each stage extracts the obligations the plan places on the product (requirements, bans, checks, scope exclusions, conditions). The key is the 1,075 claims two blind judges agree on; the owner's sampled and disputed items are not settled yet, so quality numbers are preliminary.
benchmarks.scoring: Silent misses on judge-agreed obligations (lower is better), and model seconds per 1,000 words.

sources.label: Agent runs
sources.detail: 5 files unreadable since 4:30 PM: vm.corrections/runs/2026-11-06/vm.corrections--missing.json (corrects names a missing run), vm.corrections/runs/2026-11-06/vm.corrections--foreign.json (corrects names another writer's run), vm.corrections/runs/2026-11-06/vm.corrections--cycle-a.json (corrects forms a cycle), vm.corrections/runs/2026-11-06/vm.corrections--cycle-b.json (corrects forms a cycle), vm.corrections/runs/2026-11-06/vm.corrections--fork-early.json (corrects conflict: a later correction wins). 7 runs from 1 writer read 4:30 PM (7 observed, 0 benchmark).
